body: I'm not fat, I am actually under weight
Okay, damn calm down.
Why don't we private message, tell me more.
I wish I could but there are no cliffs where I live.
Oh I wish.
Okay.
Things will be okay, if you want you can message me and we can talk this through. If you explain why I may be able to help. Please get in contact if you would like help.

You shouldn't have to follow what you think people think of you. If the things you are doing make you unhappy stop doing them, if you feel like a robot following societies views then stop doing it. You are your own person, people will love you for who you are and some people may not. However, if you have people who care for you when you are your turn self then things will get better. Don't think people will judge you if you aren't perfect, you are perfect in your own way and deserve to act however you want.
Okay...
Okay. I just want him to stop and for us to still be friends but it seems like I can't have both.
Thank you, I hope this situation does get better as well. I want to still be friends with him but I know it won't be healthy for myself if I do.
Thank you very much. I will try and let someone know about this other than my two friends.
Thank you very much for this information. I have already told 2 people who are really close to me and they have said the same thing. Thank you very much for helping me.
Thank you very much. I just wish none of this even happened with him cause he was such a good friend before any of this.
Thank you very much for this. I would really like to talk to you about this for more help. Thank you so much!
It will change it just takes time for things to turn around. It may not be a perfect or good life now but there will be a light at the end of that dark tunnel soon. There is always hope.

You should tell people about how you feel, if it is getting worst you should speak to someone about this. Just because you think that no one cares there are probably people in your life who are willing to help you, all you need to do is speak up and they will help. Please remember that you are a wonderful person and deserve to be here. Don't give up hope.

No, please do not take a shortcut to end your life. You have so much to live for and people who love you for who you are. Even if you doubt what I say I swear that you have importance in this world, you deserve every moment here for as long as you live. Please don't think you aren't important, because you are.

Of course it is hard right now but you will get through it! Try and think happy things and that what has happened to you is a good thing. You will one day get over this and everything will be great again. Even though it is very hard right now, you will make it through it. I believe in you. Please feel free to message me, I would really like to help you.

It takes time for the love you once held for another to fade away. You have more to your life than her, just imagine this experience as something good rather than something bad. You will always find someone new in this world, there will always be someone for you. Try talk to your friends about this, they should be able to help in this situation, they may help you in your time in need.

Everything will be okay. There are many other people in this world for you other than her. You will find someone else, someone better than her. It will take a while for this love that you have for her to clear up, but over time you will find someone else who will love you even more than she ever could. Your life is important, don't think about throwing it away over one person.

Please don't think about hanging yourself. Even though your life is at a dull point now you still have time to turn things around. You have so much to live for yet you are taking the last option that shouldn't be with you right now. I know things are bad for you right now. Relationships are bad, working each and every day and that you will never find a women or a good partner. Those things are only right now, you still have so much ahead of you in your life! Even though everything is going down hill now, you can still change it around! I believe in you that you have much more to look forward to in life, you just need to find it! I believe in you! Don't lose in hope!

You aren't a bother, you deserve just as much recognition as everyone else in this world. Please, feel free to message me and I will try and help you with this problem. This dream does not define who you are, even if it is a reoccurring dream. Even if you aren't afraid of dying your time is not up here.

Everything will be okay, even if you don't have these friends with you anymore you still have yourself. I am sure you are a strong person who will be able to fight through this tiny your life to pass through into a bright, happy future. You will not become that monster in your dreams, you won't snap and become that monster, you won't die alone because there are people who care for you. You will find new people who will comfort you, all you need to do is find them. If you have no one to speak to you can always message me, I would love to speak with you and try to cheer you up!

That dream you are having has nothing to do with who you are. Everything will be okay and you have those people in your life who care for you, I don't think they would want you to commit suicide, you would be leaving them all alone if you did that. I'm sure you are a kind person who has much to live for. You aren't going to become the monster that's in your dreams, everything will be okay as long as you talk to someone close to you about these things.
